title: Particles by verb frame
description: The particle follows the verb, not the preposition: a location is で under an action verb; answer takes に; walk takes まで for its destination; frequency before place.

cases.sentence: his father eats there twice a week .
cases.expect: 彼の父はそこで週に二回食べる。
cases.note: adjunct order: the place before the frequency is as natural as after it; the verdict recorded on test 300 accepts this order

cases.sentence: i refuse to answer the question .
cases.expect: 私は質問に答えることを断る。

cases.note: the corpus reference for 'i walk to the park' (test 179) uses に for the destination of walking; まで is the other natural choice
